eligibility: Only timeout cases with all nine hypotheses created, all fourteen preterminal judgments complete, and up to four missing final-generation judgments.
new_judgments: Only missing call names; same frozen prompts/models/effort/seed. Existing judgments reused by exact call name and request hash.
when: After both original arms finish, avoiding extra provider concurrency.
usage: Preserve original unknown consumption; exact cumulative token cap and cost comparability remain unverified where original usage is unknown.
reporting: Keep original timeout/failed records unchanged. Report supplemental completion separately; do not classify it as completion within the original 45-minute cap.
